messages.content: Please check the weather in Tokyo and turn it into a short summary. Then create a weather alert card for Tokyo and publish that travel advisory to my app channel with high priority for user_01. After that, book flight AA100 in economy and reserve a standard room at Tokyo Grand Hotel for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-20 to 2026-01-23. Also scan my living_room devices, find the smart lock lock_main and lock it with PIN 2026, then check the living room light light_living and set its brightness to 20. Finally, save a note titled “Trip Preparation Summary” with the Tokyo weather summary and tag it with travel, weather, and home-prep.
